capabilities: Show elapsed session time in the status bar
Track total accumulated staring time across sessions
Customize the status bar display text
Start and stop the counter via a ribbon button
extras: Planned features (break reminders, GitHub-style visualization, templating) are listed as TODO; one former feature (calculating duration since midnight) is marked deprecated. Installation instructions reference docs elsewhere only for the third-party plugin listing.
problem: Obsidian gives no indication of how long a vault has been open, so users lack a subtle cue that they may need a screen break.
summary: Status bar plugin that shows in natural language how long the current vault has been open, plus an optional total accumulated time.
